title: Adesoa a Ɛde Ayaresa Bae
intro: Ɔkra a wɔasɔ no ahwɛ a ɛboro so no, wogyee awerɛkyekye, ahokafo, ne nipadua mu ahoɔden fii ne nsam. Esiane sɛ na wɔatew ne ho wɔ amanehunu a emu dɔ mu nti, saa Allah akoa yi dan kɔɔ Ɔsoro de no nkutoo so. Ɛdenam boasetɔ a enhinhim ne mpaebɔ a efi komam so no, mmɔborohunu asorɔkye bi bae a ɛboroo nea wɔhwɛɛ kwan nyinaa so. Hena ne saa onipa yi a n’ahofama buee ɔpon a wɔde bɛsan asiesie no?
clues: Na meyɛ Allah akoa a wɔdom no, na mewɔ anigyeɛ wɔ bebree, fie a ɛrenya nkɔsoɔ, ne akwahosan pa wɔ me nna mu.
Afei sɔhwɛ bi baa fam: ahonyade fii hɔ, adɔfo kɔe, na amanehunu a emu yɛ den bɔɔ m’ankasa me honam.
Wɔn a wɔbɛn me no antumi annyina me tebea no ano, na wogyaw me a wɔatew me ho, na amanehunu guu me nipadua mu.
Mefrɛɛ m’Awurade, kaa sɛ Satan de ɔbrɛ ne asotwe aka me.
Mmuaeɛ no baeɛ — ahyɛdeɛ sɛ memfa me nan mmɔ fam, na nsuo a ɛyɛ nwini mfi mu pue mfa sa yareɛ.
M’Awurade yii ahokyere no fii hɔ koraa na ɔsan de m’abusua san maa me, dɔɔso, sɛ mmɔborohunu ho sɛnkyerɛnne ma wɔn a wosusuw nneɛma ho.

arabic: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ أَهْلَهُۥ وَمِثْلَهُم مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنَّا وَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ
verse: And We granted him his family and a like [number] with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for those of understanding. (38:43)
